description:
[Trading Data API] Aggregated perpetual-futures funding rate & open interest from Binance + Bybit, with 7-day average funding, 24h OI change, and a long/short bias signal.

**Example:** `/v1/funding-oi?symbol=BTC`

Use when you want perp funding rates and open interest aggregated from Binance and Bybit to gauge leverage and crowding. Not for Hyperliquid-specific data (use hyperliquid) or spot-vs-perp carry (use basis).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).

symbol.description: Required. Base crypto symbol (e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL). Mapped to the <SYMBOL>USDT perpetual ticker on Binance/Bybit.

name: funding_oi
